message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the Canadian public holidays that created **long weekends** (i.e., a three‑day weekend) in 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, it automatically gives you a long weekend; if it falls on a Thursday or a Tuesday, you can still enjoy a “four‑day” weekend, but those dates are not shown here.)

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB) | Monday | ✔ | Creates Mon‑Tue long weekend |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Friday | ✔ | Creates Fri‑Sun long weekend |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | ✔ | Creates Fri‑Sun long weekend |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | ✔ | Creates Mon‑Tue long weekend |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | ✔ | Creates Mon‑Tue long weekend |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | ✔ | Creates Mon‑Tue long weekend |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | ✔ | Creates Mon‑Tue long weekend |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas | Monday | ✔ | Creates Mon‑Tue long weekend |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | ✔ | Creates Mon‑Tue long weekend |

### Quick Summary

- **Long weekends (3 days)**: Family Day (Feb 20), St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17), Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25), Boxing Day (Dec 26).
- **No long weekend**: New Year’s Day (Jan 1 – Sunday), Canada Day (Jul 1 – Saturday).

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the full list of statutory holidays for each province (including those that don’t create long weekends), let me know!
